items.imgPrompt: antique celadon incense burner with gold-traced lid, on dark mahogany desk, soft warm lamplight, slight patina on brass fittings

desc.zh: 香篆燃盡，權柄還在。換了更好的，這只隨意出了。喜歡便拿去，不必問來路。
desc.zh_cn: 香篆燃尽，权柄还在。换了更好的，这只随意出了。喜欢便拿去，不必问来路。
desc.en: The incense trail fades, but the power remains. Upgraded to a finer one — take this if you fancy it. Don't ask where it came from.

items.imgPrompt: matte black Montblanc fountain pen in open velvet case, on marble tabletop, pristine gold nib catching overhead light, almost unused

name.zh: 萬寶龍限定鋼筆（幾乎未用）
name.zh_cn: 万宝龙限定钢笔（几乎未用）
name.en: Montblanc Limited Edition Fountain Pen (Nearly New)

desc.zh: 舊約成劫，紙間之名不必再落。筆是好筆，只是那頁已翻過。
desc.zh_cn: 旧约成劫，纸间之名不必再落。笔是好笔，只是那页已翻过。
desc.en: Old promises became old shackles — no need to sign that page again. A fine pen, but the chapter is closed.

items.imgPrompt: half-full bottle of aged Japanese whisky beside a crystal tumbler, dark walnut shelf background, amber liquid catching dim warm light, slight dust on label

desc.zh: 紙醉金迷不過如此。開了一杯，餘下的與舊人無關，新人若配得上，便來。
desc.zh_cn: 纸醉金迷不过如此。开了一杯，余下的与旧人无关，新人若配得上，便来。
desc.en: Glamour is only this much. Poured one glass — the rest has nothing to do with the old flame. If you're worthy, come take it.

items.imgPrompt: folded steel tanto knife with dark wooden handle, resting on black silk cloth, visible scratches on blade near edge, dim study lighting

name.zh: 手鍛短刃（泥沼裡帶出來的）
name.zh_cn: 手锻短刃（泥沼里带出来的）
name.en: Hand-Forged Tanto (Carried Out of the Mire)

desc.zh: 十六載血澆過的影子，歸鞘之後便不必再拔。刃上有痕，介意勿擾。
desc.zh_cn: 十六载血浇过的影子，归鞘之后便不必再拔。刃上有痕，介意勿扰。
desc.en: Shadow tempered by sixteen years of blood — once sheathed, it need not be drawn again. Blade is scarred; don't bother me if you mind.

items.imgPrompt: ornate bronze hand mirror with mother-of-pearl inlay, lying face-up on grey linen, visible tarnish and small chip on frame edge, natural daylight from window

desc.zh: 明鏡再蒙塵，幾秋隔海都映不回當初那人了。鏡尚可照人，人已非舊。
desc.zh_cn: 明镜再蒙尘，几秋隔海都映不回当初那人了。镜尚可照人，人已非旧。
desc.en: The mirror gathers dust again — years across the sea couldn't reflect that person anymore. It still shows a face, just not the old one.

items.imgPrompt: rolled calligraphy scroll with red silk ribbon, partially unrolled on rosewood table, ink slightly faded at edges, warm interior light

desc.zh: 青煙散處，玉樽隔了舊人。寫時意氣風發，如今看來——不過塵煙碾盡的輕狂。隨緣出。
desc.zh_cn: 青烟散处，玉樽隔了旧人。写时意气风发，如今看来——不过尘烟碾尽的轻狂。随缘出。
desc.en: Where the smoke clears, the jade cup divides old acquaintances. Written in a rush of pride — now it's just recklessness ground to dust. Letting it go on a whim.

pendingOutings.line: 充电线又坏了，我一个住在手机里的为什么还要买充电线。
